text: This is divided into Elementary Level, Intermediate Level, and Advanced Level. For group study, we can set the study periond according requirement. Duration: Four weeks from mid July Tuition Fee and Others (PAID IN RMB): Tuition: RMB 3000 The Activity Fee: RMB 1000 includes Laoshan trip, Beer Museum, etc(the activities include the tour and the visits arranged in the afternoon and weekends) Accommodations: Facilities in Room: Telephone, TV-set, private toilet, air conditioner, wardrobe and desk, etc. Room Rate (ON CAMPUS, PAID IN RMB): Single room: RMB 120 /day Double room: RMB 80 /day/person Food & Miscellaneous Fee: approx. RMB 2500 four weeks (depending on individual lifestyle) Schedule: The students would take the course according to their Chinese level. And the students should attend the course from 8 am to 12 am, from Monday to Friday, 20 class hours one week. Courses: Oral Chinese, Listening, Comprehensive Reading, Chinese culture, practising Chinese by looking pictures and some related subjects.
